Class ColorField

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.AbstractPanelElement
com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.ColorField
All Implemented Interfaces:
PanelElement
public class ColorField extends AbstractPanelElement
A color setting: a swatch showing the color, and a lens onto it. Clicking the swatch (or Enter on it) opens a modal dialog over the screen with two tabs:
  • Basic, the default: Minecraft's sixteen dye colors in rainbow order, rows of six with the four neutrals last, each shown by its dye item, named in a tooltip (vanilla's color name, "Light Blue"), the current one outlined. Clicking one sets the color.
  • Custom: a saturation and brightness square, a hue bar, a transparency bar over a checkerboard (with alpha(true)), the color before and now side by side, and a hex field.
Changes are written as they are made, so the screen behind shows them at once. Done keeps them; Cancel and Escape write back the color from before the dialog opened. 
ColorField.builder()
        .state(() -> config.glowColor, v -> config.glowColor = v)
        .alpha(true)
        .build();

The value

An int, the consumer's: get is read every frame and set receives every change. Without alpha it is 0xRRGGBB (the top byte is ignored when read and zero when written); with alpha(true) it is 0xAARRGGBB. A dye is opaque, so picking one writes alpha FF.

The hex field

Typing is free; only valid hex is written: #RRGGBB, and with alpha #AARRGGBB too (six digits then keep the current transparency); the # is optional. While the text is not valid it shows red and nothing is written; when the field loses focus it goes back to the color's hex.

The kind of screen

The swatch is a button of the screen's kind (vanilla's stone button in the Default look, MenuKit's raised gray in the Panel look) with the color inside it, over a checkerboard when it has alpha. The dialog is a panel on the same screen, so it draws in the same kind, its tabs, buttons and hex field included. It needs a screen: on the HUD the swatch only shows the color.

      Description copied from interface: PanelElement
